Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values and three bidders. Dominant strategy is to bid one’s true value: payment equals the second-highest bid, so truthful bidding maximizes expected profit. Overbidding risks winning and paying above my value if a rival’s value is slightly higher; underbidding risks losing when the price would have been below my value. No exploitable history and only one round, so no signaling. Use allowed $0.1 increments and bid exactly my value: 32.0.
